observations: Front view of a large solar panel.
Monocrystalline cells with a half-cut design (horizontal dividing line).
No manufacturer labels, brand names, or specification stickers are visible in the photo.
The panel appears to be in a warehouse or shop setting.

claims.evidence: No brand name is visible on the frame or cells in photo 0.
The technical specification sticker, which confirms wattage, is not shown.
The rear of the panel is not visible to confirm if it has glass or cells on the back.

risks.risk: The actual wattage may be significantly lower than 650W.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel.

risks.risk: The panel may not be bifacial.
risks.proof: A photo of the rear side of the panel showing the cell structure.

risks.risk: The panel may have internal cell damage or low output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter test of Open Circuit Voltage (Voc) and Short Circuit Current (Isc) in direct sunlight.

proof_requests: Photo of the technical specification sticker on the back of the panel.
Photo of the rear side of the panel.
Video of a multimeter test showing the panel's output in sunlight.
response.reason: The brand and wattage (650W) are the primary drivers of value for this item and cannot be verified from the single front-facing photo. A photo of the manufacturer's specification label is required.
